inputs.title: Lazy Sunday with Biscuit
inputs.image_prompt: A low-poly 3D floating island: a small chunk of land built from faceted, flat-shaded polygons with crisp edges, its rocky underside tapering to a point, hovering in empty space. On the island: A bright green grassy slope tilts gently from back to front, bathed in warm morning light. In the center, two figures sit side by side on a small picnic blanket: one in a denim jacket and one in a soft lilac sweater, sharing halves of a silver foil burrito. Right beside them, a scruffy tan dog proudly clamps a slightly oversized bright lime tennis ball in his jaws. Along the back edge, two tiny figures toss a red disc beneath the slender trunk of a single palm tree. Nothing extends beyond its edges: no horizon, sky or distant scenery behind it. Plain seamless pale gray background with nothing else in it.
